title: Manufacturer Copay Program Enrollment and Consent — Specialty Pharmacy Program Member Terms
content:
These terms set out, for each tier of the Specialty Pharmacy Program, how a member is enrolled in a drug manufacturer's copay program, how long the member's consent lasts, when re-enrollment outreach begins, and whether a member without a manufacturer program is referred to a charitable foundation.

| Tier | Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy enrolls the member on the member's behalf | Member's own consent required before enrollment | Consent valid for (months) | Re-enrollment outreach starts (calendar days before the program year renews) | Members without a manufacturer program referred to independent charitable foundations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | No |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | No |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | Yes | Yes | 12 | 30 | Yes |

## Terms explained

1. **Enrollment by the pharmacy.** On every tier, Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy enrolls the member in the manufacturer copay program on the member's behalf.
2. **Consent.** On every tier the member's own consent is required before enrollment in a manufacturer copay program. The consent remains valid for 12 months, after which it must be renewed.
3. **Re-enrollment outreach.** Outreach starts 30 calendar days before the program year renews.
4. **Foundation referral.** Referral to independent charitable foundations is available on Northbridge Specialty Exclusive, Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist, Northbridge Specialty Care Management and Northbridge Specialty Total Care. It is not available on Northbridge Specialty Open Access or Northbridge Specialty Preferred.

## Illustration (assumed dates)

- A consent recorded on February 10 of one year stays valid for 12 months, through the corresponding point of February the following year, and must then be renewed.
- For a program year that renews on January 1, outreach begins 30 calendar days earlier, on December 2.
